dataSources.backtest: Binance public REST (klines + funding + long/short account ratio + taker buy/sell volume)

entryRule.expression: Trade only when |conviction - CONVICTION_FLAT| > ENTRY_THRESHOLD; conviction > CONVICTION_FLAT + ENTRY_THRESHOLD => LONG, conviction < CONVICTION_FLAT - ENTRY_THRESHOLD => SHORT. Conviction itself is the directional trend/momentum core (EMA_FAST/EMA_SLOW, TREND_WEIGHT/MOMENTUM_WEIGHT, saturating at TREND_FULL_SEP/MOMENTUM_FULL_RET) — the OOS earner — modulated by the Fear & Greed gate (bounded GATE_MIN..GATE_MAX).

exitRule.expression: Exit to FLAT when |conviction - CONVICTION_FLAT| <= ENTRY_THRESHOLD (the directional edge collapses inside REGIME_FLATTEN_BAND of flat), OR on a side flip (decideTrade.flip).

conditions: Fear & Greed leaves the extreme-fear band (rises above FEAR_EXTREME=25) so the contrarian gate (GATE_MAX/GATE_MIN) no longer favors the long -> reassess.
Either divergence leg goes warming (fewer than ZSCORE_MIN_OBS=12 past obs over the ZSCORE_WINDOW=48 window, z=0) -> no actionable divergence overlay -> rely on the directional core only.
Funding leaves the stretched regime the read relied on (|funding| drops below FUNDING_STRETCHED=0.0005) -> regime gain relaxes toward 1.0.

positionSizing.expression: sizeBps = 10000 * |conviction - CONVICTION_FLAT| / CONVICTION_FLAT (0 bps at flat, 10000 bps at the extreme), scaled by the account risk budget; the divergence/funding RISK FILTER may trim by RISK_FILTER_TRIM=0.5 or veto at RISK_FILTER_VETO_INTENSITY=0.6 (inert OOS by the committed ablation).

steps: Report on a HELD-OUT out-of-sample window: total return, win rate, max drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino vs buy-and-hold.

notes: HEADLINE OOS (backtest/report-momentum.json, aggregate held-out 30% window, net of 10+10 bps cost): totalReturn -0.32% (a small LOSS, NOT alpha) vs buy-and-hold -43.5% over the same bars. This is a DRAWDOWN OVERLAY, not an edge: maxDrawdown 17.7% vs buy-and-hold 58.3%.

The OOS earner is the vanilla directional EMA trend/momentum core (EMA_FAST/EMA_SLOW, TREND_WEIGHT/MOMENTUM_WEIGHT). The Fear & Greed contrarian gate and the divergence/funding RISK FILTER are near-INERT out-of-sample by the committed ablation — they are documented here for transparency, not claimed as drivers.

This live BTC example: F&G=23 (extreme-fear) with funding 0.0006212 above FUNDING_STRETCHED=0.0005, so the contrarian regime favors LONG (favoredSide=+1, regimeGain at REGIME_GATE_MAX=1.35). The divergence legs (crowdZ/flowZ) need ~30d of positioning history that the live read alone does not carry, so they are null/warming here and the divergence overlay contributes no edge on this bar.
cmcId for BTC is the CMC numeric id (1) from search_cryptos; it is never guessed.
The live CMC narrative term is attention MOMENTUM, not sentiment polarity (folded as a bounded advisory; a strict {0,0} no-op when absent).

DEFAULT-vs-SELECTED disclosure (no contradiction): engineConstants here are the MODULE DEFAULT export values (EMA_FAST=20 / EMA_SLOW=50, allowShort path enabled, src/signal/momentum.ts) — the single source of truth the rules cite by name. The SELECTED headline backtest (backtest/report-momentum.json) runs the swept winner 'long-only + EMA 30/80' (emaFast=30 / emaSlow=80, allowShort=false), chosen on the in-sample 70% only. So the snapshot constants (20/50) and the reported config (30/80 long-only) intentionally differ — the same default-vs-selected split README.md and SKILL.md disclose — not a copied-then-drifted value.
